styles.a: Bright flat storybook fantasy illustration, clean shapes, soft light, cheerful saturated colours, friendly and inviting, no blood, no gore, no scary faces, no text, no letters, no numbers.
styles.sprite: Bright flat storybook fantasy game sprite seen from directly above (top-down), chunky rounded friendly shapes, thin dark outline, soft shading, cheerful colours, cute not scary, no blood, no gore, no text, no letters.
styles.icon: Bright flat storybook fantasy game icon, one bold object centred on a soft plain pale background, thick friendly shapes, thin dark outline, glowing magical light, cheerful colours, no text, no letters, no numbers.
styles.portrait: Bright flat storybook fantasy character portrait, head and shoulders, front view, friendly smile, thin dark outline, soft light, plain soft coloured background, cheerful colours, no blood, no text, no letters.
styles.ground: Flat top-down tiling ground texture for a children's fantasy game, calm soft colours with low contrast so small things on top stand out, even all over, no big features, no shadows from the side, no text.

pictures.name: card
pictures.prompt: Wide storybook landscape, calm pale dusk sky across the top with a few soft clouds, a small friendly knight in silver armour and a blue cape stands in the middle of a green castle field with a tiny castle far behind, bright glowing spinning blades circling the knight in a ring of golden light, a ring of cartoon goblins and round green slimes marching in from every edge of the picture, wide landscape picture for a game title card, the knight small and clear in the middle.
